note: G4 value vectors for the runner's write check (scripting-4d-1). Read by the page copy (packages/behaviors/src/value-rules.js, through packages/behaviors/tests/value-rules.test.js) and by the server copy (packages/server/src/send-policy.js, through packages/server/test/value-rules.test.js), so the two implementations cannot drift: 'field' and 'value' are one candidate write, 'ok' is the verdict, and 'message' is the EXACT refusal text both must give when ok is false. The 'node' group is checked through authorizeNodeSend and the 'light' group through authorizeLightSend. JSON cannot carry NaN or Infinity (JSON.stringify writes both as null), so the NaN cases G4 names ([NaN, 0, 0] and a NaN in a scale) are asserted as NUMBERS in both test files and deliberately do not appear here — a null-vector proves a different thing (a non-number), and saying it proved NaN was 4b-2 W5's bug.
